business_problem: Poste Italiane needed to use its large, distributed data estate and national omnichannel service network more effectively so employees could respond faster during customer interactions, customers could access services more naturally and inclusively, and marketing experiences could be tailored to individual context.
solution_summary: Poste Italiane implemented its AI program on top of an internal, next-generation distributed data architecture described as a data mesh. The company says this decentralized foundation makes domain data available directly to business units in real time, with the accessibility, context, and quality needed to train and use AI models effectively. That data layer is paired with large-scale Cloud and Edge Computing infrastructure distributed across Italy and tied to the Group's omnichannel service platform. On top of this foundation, Poste Italiane deployed an evolved digital assistant that uses generative AI to provide employees with faster real-time answers during customer interactions, an AI-supported telephone booking service that enables natural voice conversations for appointment scheduling, and generative AI algorithms integrated into the new Poste Italiane single app to hyper-personalize customer experiences.

solution_components.name: distributed data architecture (data mesh)
solution_components.role: Provides decentralized, real-time, contextualized data access across domains as the foundation for training and using AI models effectively.

solution_components.name: Cloud and Edge Computing
solution_components.role: Supplies the large-scale infrastructure base that supports the Group's AI-enabled omnichannel services.

solution_components.name: evolved digital assistant
solution_components.role: Uses generative AI to provide employees with timely answers in real time during customer interactions.

solution_components.name: AI-supported telephone booking service
solution_components.role: Uses AI-enabled voice interaction so customers can converse naturally and make appointments by phone.

solution_components.name: generative AI algorithms
solution_components.role: Power hyper-personalization based on customer characteristics and context within Poste Italiane's customer experience flows.

solution_components.name: Poste Italiane single app
solution_components.role: Serves personalized digital experiences to customers using the integrated generative AI capabilities.

data_flow: Operational data is managed by domain in Poste Italiane's distributed data mesh and exposed in real time to business units. That contextualized, high-quality data supports AI model training and use on the Group's cloud and edge infrastructure, after which generative AI services are delivered to employees through the digital assistant, to customers through the phone booking service, and to app users through the single app.
business_outcome: Poste Italiane reports faster employee response support in customer interactions, more accessible and inclusive appointment booking through natural voice conversations, and more personalized customer experiences across its digital channels.
architecture_clues: Data mesh adopted as a next-generation distributed data architecture.
Data is managed by domains rather than through centralized certification.
Business structures can access data in real time.
Cloud and Edge Computing are part of the underlying infrastructure.
The Group says it has the largest technology infrastructure in Italy, distributed throughout the country.
The omnichannel platform spans physical channels and digital channels.
